news_cards.title: Bihar ke Kisanon ko Hari Mirch ki Kheti par 24,000 tak Anudan
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne kisanon ko hari mirch ki kheti par anudan dena shuru kiya hai
Is yojana ke tahat kisanon ko 24,000 tak ka anudan diya jayega
Yeh anudan kisanon ko hari mirch ki kheti ke liye pratsahit karne ke liye diya ja raha hai

news_cards.title: Mithila Makhana ko GI Tag Mila, Australia ko Hua Pehla Sea Shipment
bullets: Mithila makhana ko GI tag milne ke baad Australia ko pehla sea shipment ho gaya hai
Yeh shipment Mithila makhana ki gunvatta aur prasidhhi ko badhane mein madadgar sabit hoga
Mithila makhana ki kheti Bihar ke kisanon ke liye ek naya avsar ban rahi hai

news_cards.title: Bihar mein 55,279 Padon par Bahali, Cabinet ki Bhumika
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne 55,279 padon par bahali ke liye cabinet ki bhumika tai ki hai
Is yojana ke tahat naye karmchariyo ki bharti ki jayegi
Yeh bahali Bihar ke yuvaon ke liye naye avsar pradan karegi

news_cards.title: Bihar Sangrahalaya Sthapana Divas par Antarrashtriya Lok Kala Pradarshani
bullets: Bihar sangrahalaya sthapana divas par antarrashtriya lok kala pradarshani aayojit ki jayegi
Is pradarshani mein Bihar ke lok kala ka pradarshan kiya jayega
Yeh pradarshani Bihar ke sanskriti ko badhava dena mein madadgar sabit hogi

news_cards.title: Bihar mein RERA ki Karyapranali ko Badhava Dene ke Liye Naye Nirdesh
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne RERA ki karyapranali ko badhava dene ke liye naye nirdesh jari kiye hain
Is yojana ke tahat ghar kharidaron ke hiton ko sarvoccha prathmikta di jayegi
Yeh naye nirdesh Bihar mein avasaayik vikas ko badhava denge

news_cards.title: Bihar mein 125 Din Rozgar Guarantee Yojana par Bhumika
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne 125 din rozgar guarantee yojana par bhumika tai ki hai
Is yojana ke tahat yuvaon ko rozgar ke naye avsar pradan kiye jayenge
Yeh yojana Bihar ke yuvaon ke liye ek naya avsar ban rahi hai

news_cards.title: Bihar mein PM Surya Ghar Yojana par Bhumika
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne PM surya ghar yojana par bhumika tai ki hai
Is yojana ke tahat logon ko surya urja se chalne wale ghar banane mein madad ki jayegi
Yeh yojana Bihar mein urja vikas ko badhava dena mein madadgar sabit hogi

news_cards.title: Bihar mein Delhi se AC Busen, Chhath Puja Special
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne delhi se AC busen chalane ka faisla kiya hai
Is yojana ke tahat logon ko delhi se bihar tak safar karne mein aasani hogi
Yeh yojana Bihar mein parivahan vikas ko badhava dena mein madadgar sabit hogi
